notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
rationale: The order is a one-paragraph amendment of Executive Order 11017 that added the Chairman of the Tennessee Valley Authority to the Recreation Advisory Council. Executive Order 11278 of May 4, 1966, section 106, expressly states that Executive Orders 11017, 11069 and 11218 are superseded, the supersession names this order, has no exception, and the superseding order creates a different council, so the order had no force on 2026-10-14. The two history observations (an Office of the Federal Register API disposition note and a 1989 Office of the Federal Register table entry) are editorial leads that give only an upper bound of 1989-01-20; I did not rely on them and instead read the later order's own text. The recommended status is NO and rests on the held Federal Register text of Executive Order 11278 and the ACT record of its section 106.
